name: spall_move
title: Move or rename a note
description: Moves or renames a note (or a .base file). Needs update+delete on the source and create on the destination. Links in other notes are not rewritten.

path.description: Note path relative to your root (".md" optional), or a .base file

destination.description: New note path, or a folder (ending in / or existing) to move into keeping the name
